# UBL 2.1 test schemas

These unmodified OASIS Standard schemas are test fixtures, not runtime code, and are excluded from the npm files allowlist. Source URLs and SHA-256 checksums are recorded in sources.json. Each XSD retains its original copyright and full OASIS permission/disclaimer text. Those terms apply to these fixtures separately from the package MIT license. Do not remove notices or modify the specification files. Validation uses xmllint --nonet; install libxml2-utils on Ubuntu (quality CI does so).
